errors.evidence: The slice for "Няколко пъти месечно" is colored blue, not dark blue. More importantly, the description incorrectly identifies the blue slice. The blue slice is one of the medium-sized ones (visually ~9.1%), while the description treats it as one of the two smallest slices.

errors.evidence: The slice corresponding to the "Не сме организирали обучения по лидерство" category is colored blue in the pie chart, not cyan. The cyan slice in the chart corresponds to "Няколко пъти месечно" according to the legend.

errors.text_span: секторът „Няколко пъти месечно“ е оцветен в тъмносиньо и заема малък дял (приблизително 4–5%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors and values. The category "Няколко пъти месечно" is cyan, and its value is approximately 4.5% (one of the two smallest slices). The description assigns this category to the dark blue slice and also misidentifies which slice is which on the chart.
